roles.name: Data Engineer
roles.description: Builds and maintains scalable data pipelines and architectures for collecting, storing, and processing large volumes of data.

roles.name: Data Analyst
roles.description: Interprets data, analyzes trends, and produces actionable insights to support business decisions.

roles.name: Data Scientist
roles.description: Extracts insights from data using advanced analytics, statistics, and machine learning, often building predictive models.

roles.name: ML Engineer
roles.description: Specializes in deploying, optimizing, and maintaining machine learning models in production environments.

roles.name: DBMS
roles.description: Designs, implements, and manages databases, ensuring data integrity, performance, and security.

roles.name: Database Administrator
roles.description: Maintains and secures databases, performs tuning, backup, recovery, and ensures high availability.

roles.name: Business Analyst
roles.description: Bridges business needs and technology solutions by analyzing requirements and defining specifications.

roles.name: Research Scientist
roles.description: Conducts advanced research on algorithms, models, and data-driven methods, often publishing findings.

roles.name: Data Steward
roles.description: Ensures data quality, governance, and compliance across the organization.

roles.name: Data Architect
roles.description: Designs and oversees the data architecture, including data models, integration, and flows.

roles.name: Full Stack
roles.description: Combines both front-end and back-end development skills, capable of building complete web applications.

roles.name: Front End
roles.description: Responsible for building the user interface and user experience of web applications, ensuring accessibility, responsiveness, and interactivity.

roles.name: Back End
roles.description: Handles the business logic, database interactions, and server-side operations of applications, ensuring security, scalability, and reliability.

roles.name: API
roles.description: Designs and implements interfaces for communication between different software components or services, often using RESTful or GraphQL standards.

roles.name: Server
roles.description: Manages deployment, hosting, and operational aspects of applications, including configuration, scaling, and monitoring.

roles.name: DBMS
roles.description: Designs, implements, and manages databases, ensuring data integrity, performance, and security.

roles.name: Networking
roles.description: Ensures reliable, secure, and efficient communication between computers and systems within an organization or across the internet.

roles.name: DevOps
roles.description: Bridges development and operations by automating software delivery, infrastructure changes, and monitoring.

roles.name: Cloud Engineer
roles.description: Designs, implements, and maintains cloud infrastructure and services for scalability, reliability, and security.

roles.name: Security Engineer
roles.description: Protects systems and data from cyber threats by designing secure architectures, monitoring, and responding to incidents.

roles.name: UI/UX Designer
roles.description: Focuses on the design and usability of applications, ensuring a seamless and visually appealing user experience.

roles.name: Mobile Developer
roles.description: Builds applications for mobile devices, ensuring performance, usability, and compatibility across platforms.

roles.name: QA Engineer
roles.description: Ensures the quality of software through automated and manual testing, identifying bugs and verifying requirements.

roles.name: Product Manager
roles.description: Owns the product vision and roadmap, working with cross-functional teams to deliver value to users.

roles.name: SRE (Site Reliability Engineer)
roles.description: Ensures reliability, availability, and performance of large-scale systems, blending software engineering with systems engineering.

roles.name: Support Engineer
roles.description: Provides technical assistance and troubleshooting for software products and services.

roles.name: Scrum Master
roles.description: Facilitates Agile development teams, removes impediments, and ensures Scrum practices are followed.

roles.name: Technical Writer
roles.description: Creates and maintains documentation for software products, APIs, and user guides.

roles.name: Game Developer
roles.description: Designs and implements interactive games for various platforms.

roles.name: Embedded Systems Engineer
roles.description: Develops software and firmware for embedded devices and hardware.
